description: Yet another utility mod / hacked client for Minecraft Fabric 26.3.

releases.notes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This release contains lots of bugs and issues , because of that it is not production ready release**;
> **Update your dependencies before launching Combatant Client 0.3.0 (Minecraft 26.3):**
> - **Sodium 0.9.2 for Minecraft 26.3 is required:** [Download Sodium 0.9.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium/version/mc26.3-0.9.2-fabric).
> - **Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer is required.**
> - **If you use Iris, update to Iris 1.11.7:** [Download Iris 1.11.7](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris/version/1.11.7%2B26.3-fabric).
>
> Dependencies built for Minecraft 26.2 are not compatible with this release.

## Minecraft 26.3 Compatibility

* Ported Combatant Client to **Minecraft 26.3**, adapting modules, mixins, rendering pipelines, input handling, and internal systems to the updated game APIs.
* Updated compatibility with **Sodium, Iris, Fabric**, and related integrations.
* Reworked shader compilation, rendering hooks, GPU resource handling, and world-rendering integration for the updated rendering architecture.
* Fixed compatibility issues involving shader variants, hand rendering, camera rotations, and rendering backends.

## Combat & Movement

* Expanded **anticheat compatibility presets** across supported modules, introducing Grim-specific behavior for interactions, rotations, reach limits, and movement.
* Significantly improved **Scaffold**, including more accurate placement geometry, rotation handling, tick-based placement timing, and movement prediction.
* Improved **Surround and SelfTrap**, with better support-block planning and crystal obstruction handling.
* Added an input-driven **BHOP mode** to Speed and refined movement behavior in NoSlow, Sprint, Timer, NoFall, and related modules.
* Improved block placement scheduling and inventory interaction timing across several automation features.

## Visuals & Rendering

* **Fixed MediaPlayer's animated glass chromatic aberration**, restoring flowing chromatic effects during music playback while preserving the static glass appearance when playback stops.
* Significantly improved **font rendering**, introducing OpenType shaping, kerning, ligatures, improved Unicode handling, and bidirectional text support.
* Improved **MSDF and bitmap font rendering** with adaptive raster selection, sharper small text, and more efficient glyph atlas management.
* Improved **ESP shader precision** using higher-precision intermediate targets to reduce color banding.
* Optimized **Tracers** by batching HUD arrows into a single mesh and draw call.
* Reduced unnecessary allocations and repeated calculations in ESP, Predictions, WorldParticles, and other visual effects.
* Improved screen-space projection caching and rendering efficiency.
* Adapted **ReimaginedVisual** sky rendering to the updated Minecraft version while retaining its original visual implementation.

## UI & User Experience

* Improved **ModuleList**, introducing dynamic module information and additional styling options for displayed details.
* Refined text rendering and typography across ClickGUI, HUD components, chat, and other interfaces.
* Introduced a unified **keyboard and mouse input system**, improving key bindings, modifier handling, input focus, and text entry.
* Improved Unicode text composition and fallback font handling.
* Refined HUD components and integrated interfaces, including MediaPlayer and Xaero map-related UI elements.
* Continued improving English and Russian localization.

## Fixes & Optimization

* Fixed multiple Minecraft 26.3 rendering compatibility and runtime issues.
* Improved integration with supported **OpenGL, Vulkan, and Iris** rendering paths.
* Fixed silent rotations unintentionally affecting the camera and restored affected rendering hooks.
* Improved post-processing stability and shader resource handling.
* Addressed additional movement, placement, interaction, and module-state edge cases.

...

This update brings **a large batch of new modules, major visual improvements, custom Iris/Sodium interfaces, and numerous fixes and optimizations**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Update your dependencies before launching Combatant Client 0.2.1 (Minecraft 26.2):**
> - **Sodium 0.9.2 is required:** [Download Sodium 0.9.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium/version/mc26.2-0.9.2-fabric).
> - **If you use Iris, update to Iris 1.11.4:** [Download Iris 1.11.4](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris/version/1.11.4+26.2-fabric).

## Modules & Gameplay

* Added **40+ modules** across Combat, Movement, Player, and Misc, including AimAssist, Surround, AutoTrap, AvoidHazards, HoleSnap, AutoPotion, ChestStealer, and many others.
* Replaced AutoTotem and AutoEat with **Offhand**, combining offhand management, protection, and automatic consumption.
* Improved inventory interaction, slot handling across different screens, targeting, and several existing modules.

## Visuals & Rendering

* Reworked **TargetESP**, revisiting classic effects, refactoring existing modes, and adding new visuals such as Caustics.
* Added **entity-only depth rendering** for world-space effects, allowing overlays to remain visible through terrain while still respecting entity depth.
* Expanded **JumpCircles** with new modes, including Shockwave.
* Rebuilt **TotemFX** with procedural bursts, particles, and expanding ground waves for self and recently attacked opponents' totem pops.
* Updated **HitEffect**, including a new Blast shockwave mode, and continued work on **Trails** and other visual effects.
* Significantly reworked the **liquid-glass rendering system throughout the UI**, with refraction and material effects inspired in part by [liquidGL](https://github.com/naughtyDuk/liquidGL).

## UI & Shaderpack Integration

* Introduced **custom Iris and Sodium settings interfaces**. Their visual design is still being refined.
* Added **module subcategories** and descriptions for both **modules and HUD elements**, making features easier to discover and understand.
* Improved ClickGUI, Relations, HUD components, text selection, and settings presentation.
* Added initial **glTF model support** with material/PBR data passed to compatible **Iris shaderpack lighting** systems. This is new rendering infrastructure and is not yet used by existing visual effects.
* Added further **TAA, motion-vector, and MSAA integration** work for supported rendering paths and shader packs.

## Fixes & Optimization

* Addressed the GPU mesh-buffer upload issue behind the macOS startup failure reported in [#16](https://github.com/pivosos2007/combatant-client/issues/16).
* Made additional stability, compatibility, localization, and performance improvements across the client and rendering systems.

**Known issue:** MediaPlayer's glass material does not yet respond reliably to music through the intended chromatic effect. A hotfix may follow.

releases.notes:
# Combatant Client 0.2.0

This update mainly focuses on the **new map system, visual improvements, UI polish, rendering work and stability**.

## Map System

The new **Combatant map system is now available in production**.

* Added a custom map interface integrated with **Xaero's World Map**.
* Added player tracking, target management and player triangulation.
* Added waypoint management directly from the Combatant map UI.
* Added MapLink support for external web maps and additional player-location sources.
* Added world HUD markers for waypoints and tracked players.
* Added local location history and additional map/tracking configuration.

The system is fairly large, so more detailed documentation will be provided separately.

## Visuals

* Expanded **ESP** customization with more control over colors and different player/entity categories.
* Added a new particle mode to **HitEffect**.
* Added maximum render distance settings to **NameTags**.
* Added additional **NoRender** particle suppression options.
* Various smaller visual module improvements and rendering updates.

## Motion Blur / Rendering

* Reworked **MotionBlur** to use the new rendering infrastructure instead of the previous simpler implementation.
* The new implementation uses temporal motion data and compute-based processing for more accurate motion blur.
* Continued development of Combatant's new **deferred rendering pipeline**.

The deferred renderer itself is still **in development** and is not yet a production feature.

The long-term goal is a fully integrated high-end graphics pipeline capable of going beyond traditional Iris shader packs visually, while keeping **performance as a primary design priority**.

## UI / HUD

* Updated **Relations** and its surrounding UI.
* Improved several ClickGUI and HUD components.
* Improved text/layout behavior across the UI.
* Added additional HUD display options for timers and markers.
* Expanded and updated UI sound feedback, including new sounds for buttons, toggles, color controls and other interactions.

## Stability / Error Handling

* Added a new failure isolation and recovery system.
* A failing module or UI component can now be isolated instead of taking down unrelated client systems.
* Added module recovery/retry support and improved error diagnostics.
* Added the `@errors` command for inspecting recent client-side failures.

## Rendering / Internal

* Continued major work on the render engine, frame graph and resource management.
* Improved Vulkan/OpenGL backend handling and various rendering paths.
* Reworked parts of the UI rendering architecture and asset loading.
* Added further groundwork for dynamic lighting, volumetrics, water, reflections, temporal rendering and other future graphics features.

Most of this new graphics infrastructure remains **in development** and will become user-facing gradually as individual features are ready.

### Hotfix

* Fixed Javet V8 native detection in platform-specific slim builds.
* Restored JS-backed HUD, UI and animation features affected by this issue.

### Known Issues

* **KillEffect** may currently cause a `ConcurrentModificationException` in some cases.
* Some **ClickGUI sounds** may fail to load in release builds, including `guiyes.wav`.

Both issues are planned to be addressed in a follow-up hotfix.

This update mainly focuses on **visual improvements, UI polish, optimization and bug fixes**.

## Visuals

* Updated **Nametags, ESP, DropESP, SoundESP and Predictions** with a newer visual style.
* Updated **HitEffect** with improved visuals.
* Improved consistency between visual modules and the rest of the Combatant UI.
* Added adjustable **arrow distance and arrow scale** to Tracers.
* Fixed several **Z-buffer / depth handling issues** affecting 3D visual effects.
* Various smaller visual and rendering improvements.

## UI / HUD

* Updated **Buttons**.
* Fixed **Tooltips** and improved their overall rendering and layout.
* Improved **TabList**.
* Improved **BetterChat**, including text layout and clipping.
* Continued polishing ClickGUI, settings panels and shared UI elements.
* Fixed several cases where text, borders, dividers or other UI elements could render outside their intended bounds.
* Improved scrolling and layout behavior in several UI screens.

## Rendering / Optimization

* Slightly improved rendering and UI optimization.
* Reduced unnecessary work in several frequently used UI and HUD rendering paths.
* Improved text and MSDF font rendering.
* Improved clipping, rounded geometry, strokes, blur and other UI effects.
* Continued development of the **advanced rendering pipeline**, including tessellation and compute-based rendering.

The advanced rendering pipeline is still experimental and under active development.

## NoRender / Sodium Extra

* Expanded NoRender with additional suppression options.
* Improved compatibility with **Sodium Extra**.
* When Sodium Extra is installed, Combatant suppresses overlapping Sodium Extra rendering options while the corresponding NoRender features are active.
* Previous Sodium Extra settings are restored when those NoRender overrides are no longer needed.

## Experimental Release Builds

For 0.1.5, separate release builds for different systems are being tested.

* Added smaller platform-specific builds for **Windows, Linux and macOS**.
* Separate variants are available for supported x64 and ARM64 setups.
* These builds only contain the native components required for the selected platform.
* Redundant bundled assets and font files are removed where possible.
* A universal build is still available.

The goal is simply to reduce JAR size and avoid shipping unnecessary platform-specific files.

This distribution format is **experimental for this release** and may change or be dropped in future versions depending on how useful it turns out to be.

## Fixes

* Fixed the **ViewModel rig while climbing ladders**.
* Fixed multiple tooltip issues.
* Fixed several UI scaling, positioning and clipping problems.
* Fixed various rendering artifacts around borders, rounded surfaces and UI clipping.
* Fixed multiple **depth/Z-buffer issues** in 3D rendering.
* Various smaller UI, rendering and stability fixes.

## Known Issues

* **Relations** still requires additional fixes.
* Some **UI previews** are still incomplete or not working correctly.

## In Development

Development has also started on a **new map system**.

The current direction includes player triangulation, Duplex-based cooperation between clients and a custom map UI/rendering framework.

This work is still at a **very early stage**. It is not available in production, and even in development builds the individual parts are not yet integrated into a complete usable system.

More details will be shared once the feature becomes more mature.

## Added

- Added **Visual Preview** for **Chams** and **ViewModel**.
  - Tune visual settings without leaving the preview scene.
  - Chams preview supports camera orbit, distance adjustment and subject rotation.
  - ViewModel uses a fixed preview camera for first-person positioning.
  - Preview settings can be hidden or shown while tuning.
  - Added view reset and dedicated preview controls.

- Added an optional **anatomical player animation rig** to **ViewModel**.
  - Disabled by default.
  - Added **Hybrid**, **Smooth** and **Combat** animation styles.
  - Added adjustable animation strength.
  - Covers locomotion, combat, item-use and other player motion states.
  - Held items follow the animated player rig.

- Added **item preview** to **BetterChat**.
  - Item-containing chat messages can now open a dedicated interactive item preview from the context menu.
  - The preview includes the item tooltip alongside the rendered item.

- Added expanded **Unicode / multilingual font fallback**.
  - Improved text rendering for characters not covered by the primary Combatant fonts.
  - Added fallback coverage for CJK, Arabic, Hebrew and multiple Indic and Asian writing systems.
  
- Added Javet native libraries for ARM.
  - Added ARM support for Unix-like systems, including macOS.

## Improved

### Tooltips

- Reworked the custom tooltip presentation.
- Added more control over tooltip visuals:
  - background alpha;
  - theme gradient strength;
  - stroke alpha;
  - shadow alpha;
  - header alpha;
  - divider alpha;
  - gradient angle offset.
- Improved theme integration and visual consistency between regular tooltips and item previews.

### Armor HUD

- Reworked the **Armor** HUD presentation.
- Added a new theme-aware matte panel style.
- Added configurable background alpha and theme gradient strength.
- Updated dividers, surface shading and item presentation to better match the rest of the HUD.

### ClickGUI

- Reworked the module **Settings** panel visuals.
- Updated panel surface, header, dividers, close control and active-state presentation.
- Improved consistency between settings surfaces and the newer Combatant UI style.

### HUD

- Added gradient-capable header icons to supported HUD panels.
- Continued visual consistency improvements across shared HUD panel layouts.

## Known Issues

* **Anatomical Rig:** armor trims can render incorrectly, displaying the full armor-trim atlas across the armor geometry. The issue has been observed with Netherite armor, but other armor and trim combinations may also be affected.

* **Anatomical Rig:** the climbing animation is currently broken. While climbing ladders, the legs bend away from the ladder instead of toward it.

* **Settings Panel:** the bottom fade can partially obscure larger settings before they are fully visible. This is especially noticeable when a large control is the last setting, as it cannot be scrolled far enough above the fade area.

* **Function Bind Settings:** the hover card stroke can extend outside the intended setting bounds.

* **Tooltips:** there is currently no visual tooltip example/live preview available inside the element settings.

* **Tooltips:** stroke thickness incorrectly scales together with the tooltip scale, causing the border thickness to change when the tooltip is resized.

* **Buttons:** the element settings currently have no visual example/live preview, making style and appearance settings difficult to tune. The settings layout also needs further cleanup.

* **Tab List** does  not have live preview, as also must be more config.

* **Locator / Bar:** the new player label visuals are still unfinished. Player rectangles are currently too horizontally stretched, take up excessive screen space, and require further visual and layout work.


...
